Zahra Tere Bachchon Ka Koi Apna Nahin Hai

Rowain To Dilasa Bhi Koi Deta Nahin Hai

Darbar Kya Hai Fizza Ye Zainab Ko Batana

Tu Dekh Chuki Is Nay Abhi Dekha Nahin Hai

Paani Ki Jaga Utra Hai Kyun Halq Mein Paikan

Pyasa Tau Kabhi Apna Lahoo Peeta Nahin Hai

Awaaz Ki Jaanib Voh Ba Andaza Chalay Hain

Akbar Teray Baba Ko Tho Kuch Dikhta Nahin Hai

Pani Pila Do So Nay Ko Hai Zahra Ka Beta

Pani Piyay Baghair Yeh Kabhi Sota Nahin Hai

Dur Cheen Chuka Looti Rida Aag Lagayee

Lekin Kyun Abhi Shimr Ka Ji Bharta Nahin Hai

Jo Log Is Hisar Mein Bachchon Ko Dekhtay

Kya Eik Musalman Ka Bhi Dil Dukhta Nahin Hai

Yeh Baat Munkashif Huwi Karbal Mein Salamat

Bin Ishq-e-Khuda Maqtal Kabhi Sajta Nahin Hai

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/zahra-tere-bachchon-ka-koi-apna-nahin-hai-nw-526c805b1685.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---',2)[2]
_, meta, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---',2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
roman_blocks = [s.splitlines() for s in '\\n'.join(line.strip() for line in roman.splitlines()).strip().split('\\n\\n')]
source_blocks = [s.splitlines() for s in body.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
assert len(roman_blocks) == len(source_blocks) == 8
assert roman_blocks[0] and len(roman_blocks[0]) == len(source_blocks[0]) == 2
for n in range(1, 8):
    assert len(roman_blocks[n]) == len(source_blocks[n]) == 3
    assert roman_blocks[n][0] == str(n)
    assert source_blocks[n][0] == '۱۲۳۴۵۶۷'[n-1]
assert [line.casefold() for b in roman_blocks for line in b[-2:]] == [line.casefold() for line in old.splitlines() if line.strip()]
print('Verified all 16 Roman verses and matching Urdu stanza structure.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 16 verses in Urdu script in the selected lyric and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both editions have the same opening couplet and seven numbered stanzas.

Read “Dur” as `دُر` (pearl) and “So Nay” as `سونے` (to sleep). Updated the title and right-to-left direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.
